explanation:
[EFFECT] The holiday feature has a simple step-change effect: on regular (non-holiday) days it has virtually no influence on predicted demand, while on public holidays the model predicts noticeably fewer rentals — roughly 13–14% lower demand. There is no gradual trend; it is a sharp drop the moment the day is flagged as a holiday.

[IMPORTANCE] This is the least important feature in the model, ranked 9th out of 9 with an importance score of only 0.008. Its influence on predicted demand is small compared to factors like hour of day or temperature.

[RECOMMENDATION] While holidays do slightly reduce overall ridership, the effect is modest, so major reductions in bike availability or staffing on public holidays are not strongly justified by this feature alone — other factors (such as hour of day and weather) should drive those decisions.
